nodes.title: Fog light
nodes.direction: Large blurred amber and deep-teal light shapes drift far back on 38-90 s cycles, under fine film grain and a vignette. Screens recompose the shapes: a warm pool behind Welcome's field, a clear calm centre for Graph, a light band across the top of Gallery.

nodes.title: Lantern dust
nodes.direction: Haze plus three depths of dust motes that only show where light falls: a soft beam from above on Welcome, the pointer's slow lantern pool, and lit nodes, which also push nearby dust outwards. Indigo floor haze is the cool companion; Graph drops the near layer.

nodes.title: Charted dark
nodes.direction: Faint, slowly morphing contour lines, revealed in amber and slate teal only where light pools fall. Lit nodes send a ring through the terrain. Welcome rings a rise under the field, Graph is the faintest open terrain, and Gallery settles into horizontal strata.

nodes.title: Clear lantern dust
nodes.direction: r001-02 with the grain removed: clean haze and a soft beam, with about half as many motes, all crisp points (the large blurry bokeh is gone). Motes still only show where light falls: the beam, the pointer's lantern pool and lit nodes, which push them gently outward.

nodes.title: Lit contours, clear
nodes.direction: r001-03 with the grain removed: faint, slowly morphing contour lines lit in amber and slate teal by drifting light pools, plus a few crisp motes from r001-02 caught by the same light. A lit node's ring sweeps through both the lines and the motes.

nodes.title: Light veils
nodes.direction: A clean replacement for r001-01's blurred shapes: five smooth translucent ribbons at different depths (far ones softer), each with a lit amber or teal upper edge. No particles and no texture. The pointer lifts the veils slightly, a lit node lights the veils near it and leaves the empty sky dark, and screens re-lay the ribbons: diagonal on Welcome, pushed to the edges on Graph, horizontal bands on Gallery.

nodes.title: Slow orbits
nodes.direction: r002-01's crisp motes with r001-01's background brought back as light: five large blurred amber and teal glows orbit slowly around the screen's centre (52-120 s) instead of the spotlight beam. Motes catch their light. No grain.

nodes.title: Distant lanterns
nodes.direction: r002-01's crisp motes around three small, clearly drawn light spheres with halos (amber, teal, cream) on tilted orbits. They grow and brighten as they swing towards you, over one wide teal glow from r001-01. A lit node makes nearby spheres flare.

nodes.title: Orrery
nodes.direction: r002-01's crisp motes inside a small planetarium: a soft amber centre glow with seven tiny light spheres on nested orbits sharing one tilt, the outer ones slower (36-150 s). Screens move and reshape the system: centred on Welcome, spread past the edges on Graph, flattened along the top on Gallery.

nodes.title: Contours, crystal
nodes.direction: Same pattern as r002-02: the terrain lines, drawn finer and smoother (smaller sampling cells, hairline strokes), darker where unlit and brighter where lit, so they read like etched glass. Slightly more motes.

nodes.title: Crystal lattice
nodes.direction: New geometric pattern for r002-02: a fine triangular lattice of hairlines and vertex points that bulges gently, like glass, wherever a light pool or the pointer's lantern sits. Lit only where light falls; r002-02's motes kept.

nodes.title: Astrolabe
nodes.direction: New geometric pattern for r002-02: fine concentric rings and radial spokes turning very slowly, with two tilted orbit ellipses echoing the orbiting lights. The centre moves per screen: under the field on Welcome, off the bottom-right corner on Graph, above the top edge on Gallery (horizon arcs). Lit only where light falls; motes kept.

nodes.title: Slow orbits, with the UI
nodes.direction: r003-01 unchanged under a replica of the app's Welcome, Study and Gallery: blurred amber and teal lights orbit slowly and crisp motes catch their light. Surfaces stay solid, as in the app; the graph area is open to the backdrop. Clicking a node lights it, and the backdrop reacts there.

nodes.title: Orbits around your focus
nodes.direction: r003-01 under the UI, with the orbits centred on what you are attending to: the question field on Welcome, the focused node on Graph (they follow it as you pan or pick another node), the hovered card on Gallery.

nodes.title: Slow orbits, glass UI
nodes.direction: r003-01 under the UI, with the header, panel, cards and thumbnails as frosted glass, so the orbiting lights pass softly behind them.

nodes.title: Contours, crystal, with the UI
nodes.direction: r003-04 unchanged under the app's UI: fine contour hairlines lit by drifting pools, with crisp motes. Surfaces stay solid, as in the app; the graph area is open to the backdrop.

nodes.title: Contours with lens
nodes.direction: r003-04 under the UI with r003-05's mesh deformation: the contour lines bulge gently, like glass, around each light pool, the pointer's lantern and every node you light.

nodes.title: Contours with lens, glass UI
nodes.direction: r004-05 (r003-04 plus r003-05's lens) with the header, panel, cards and thumbnails as frosted glass over the lines.

nodes.title: Calm orbits
nodes.direction: r004-03 refined: the anti-banding texture layer is removed, and a lit node now only warms the backdrop softly (slower in and out, smaller and fainter, no sphere flare, motes barely move). Amber and teal lights, frosted-glass UI.

nodes.title: Calm orbits, room palette only
nodes.direction: r005-01 with the backdrop strictly in the room's own neutral tokens: lights in --ink, --ink-mute, --node-open and --line; motes in ink and ink-mute. No accent (amber) and no extra colour (teal). The UI keeps the app's accent.

nodes.title: Calm orbits, amber only
nodes.direction: r005-01 without the extra colour: the teal lights become the room's own --path-muted and --line, so the backdrop is amber light on navy only. Motes in cream and ink-mute.
